evidence.activity: Employees visit schools nationwide during Money Week to teach financial literacy classes

evidence.activity: Public 'Stop svindlerne' events teaching people to protect themselves against financial fraud
evidence.quote: AL Sydbank organises “Stop svindlerne” (Stop the fraudsters) events regularly where participants can learn how to protect themselves against financial fraud.
evidence.section: Annual report > S – Social Information > Fighting crime > Efforts to combat IT fraud

evidence.activity: Sponsorships of clubs, associations, students and unions nationwide, mainly team and grassroots sports

evidence.section: Annual report > Business model > Local presence > Local support

evidence.activity: Donations to charitable cultural, popular and educational purposes through several affiliated foundations
evidence.quote: AL Sydbank makes donations to charitable cultural, popular and educational purposes via the charitable foundations the Sydbank Foundation, Arbejdernes Landsbanks Fond, Trelleborg Fonden, Den Jyske Sparekasses Støttefonde, Jelling Sparekasses Fond, Fonden for Sparekassen Farsø as well as Fonden for Sparekassen i Skals.
evidence.section: Annual report > Business model > Local presence > Local support

community.criterion: level 2: specific current charitable giving via foundations, amounts not disclosed

evidence.activity: Proposed donation to the Sydbank Foundation, subject to the annual general meeting
evidence.quote: The Board of Directors will propose to the annual general meeting that a dividend of DKK 25 per share, totalling DKK 2,145m, be distributed and that DKK 18m be donated to the Sydbank Foundation.
evidence.section: Annual report > Financial review > Proposed dividend

evidence.activity: Digital banking platforms adapted for visually and hearing impaired customers

evidence.section: Annual report > S – Social Information > AL Sydbank’s employees > Life phases and hidden disabilities

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current disability-inclusion practice, no figures

evidence.activity: Workplace aids for employees with special needs

evidence.section: Annual report > S – Social Information > Well-being and security for employees

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current accessible-workplace practice, no figures

evidence.activity: Gender balance target for management positions met in 2025
evidence.quote: AL Sydbank’s overall objective is to achieve an equal gender balance among all managers and in 2025 we achieved the subtarget that the underrepresented gender will account for at least 35% of all employees in management positions in 2025.
evidence.section: Annual report > S – Social Information > Diversity

cross_cultural.criterion: level 1: representation target and statistics only

evidence.activity: Competence mapping and talent development initiative for employees
evidence.quote: In 2025 determined efforts were made at AL Sydbank to identify employees’ competences and build the foundations for talent development.
evidence.section: Annual report > S – Social Information > AL Sydbank’s employees > Talent development

evidence.activity: Regional trust-building communication project with additional adviser training
evidence.quote: Advisers receive additional training in customer contact in order to strengthen their relationship with customers and ensure that advice is based on trust, understanding and being present.
evidence.section: Annual report > S – Social Information > Trust-building communication as a strategic project

creativity.reason: Level 1: this rests only on general language, a passing reference to donations for 'cultural' purposes, with no specific creative activity, while sponsorships are mainly in sports.

community.reason: Level 2: specific current external education (Money Week, fraud-awareness events) and community sponsorships and donations exist, but no participant numbers or amounts are disclosed for current activities.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: specific current accessibility measures (Sunflower line, digital accessibility, free NemKonto access, disability inclusion), with no reach figures.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: this rests only on general language about supporting the Danish corporate sector and serving corporate clients, focused on medium-sized and large businesses, with no specific enabling program for founders or small businesses.

ai.notes: AL Sydbank is a 2025 merger of three banks, so several targets and figures refer to the former Sydbank. The DKK 18m donation to the Sydbank Foundation is only a proposal to the AGM, so it is recorded as planned and does not raise the score. The sikkerklikker.dk anti-fraud tool was designed in 2023 and its current use is not described, so it is noted only here. Money Week is a sector program organised by Finance Denmark and no participant numbers are given. Mandatory compliance training (99.4 completion) is excluded as compliance training. The bank reports no complaints regarding discrimination in 2025. The thermal coal and oil sand exclusion in investments is a policy, not a red flag. The Board diversity policy and gender targets are treated as demographics and targets only.
